ios.desc:
Pour Decision helps you drink less or quit completely on your own terms. Answer a few quick questions to get a personalized plan tailored to your habits, your body, and your goals. Whether you want to cut back, moderate your nights out, or step down week by week to zero, Pour Decision gives you clear structure without judgment.

Key Features

YOUR PERSONAL PLAN
Tell us how you drink, a bit about your body, and your goals: better sleep, saving money, improved health, or total sobriety. Pour Decision creates a realistic roadmap with clear targets, calories and money saved, and alcohol-free days gained. Prefer custom limits? Set your own daily and weekly goals anytime.

STEP DOWN AT YOUR OWN PACE
Take the guesswork out of moderating or quitting. Follow weekly targets that help you taper gradually or maintain a healthy balance. Review past weeks, track your progress at a glance, and build lasting streaks.

SOBER & MODERATION TRACKER
Watch your alcohol-free time grow from minutes to months, or track consecutive days staying under your target limits.

"I'M ABOUT TO SLIP" CRAVING SUPPORT
When urges hit, tap one button. A guided breathing exercise slows things down, reminds you of your progress, and offers practical alternatives to pouring a drink.

MOOD CHECK-INS
Log how you feel each day in a single tap. Spot trends on a yearly mood calendar and see firsthand how fewer drinks lead to better days.

SUMMARY AT A GLANCE
See today’s drinks, units, mood, active targets, and alcohol-free time all on one central screen.

TRACKING & ANALYTICS
Monitor units, calories, and spending over time. Charts break down your weekly, monthly, and yearly averages, drinking patterns, and top beverages.

YEARLY HABIT CALENDAR
View your entire year on one screen. Toggle between drink logs and moods to identify triggers, celebrate dry streaks, and stay motivated.

200+ DRINK DATABASE
A built-in library of beers, wines, spirits, and cocktails with standard portions, ABV, and calories. Log drinks in seconds, customize sizes, or add favorites.

SIP PACER
Drink slow, stay in control. Start a session and keep your phone in your pocket. Gentle vibrations cue your next sip, helping you pace yourself naturally on social nights.

BLOOD ALCOHOL ESTIMATE (BAC)
Estimate your BAC from logged drinks in one tap to see how alcohol affects your body in real time.

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Check daily and weekly progress right from your home screen without opening the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your logs, moods,

quotes.text:
Hey there!

I want to share the alcohol tracker app that I've made for iOS.

The idea came to be when I decided I want to drink less, but not quit completely. I tried a bunch of solutions but I couldn't find the app quite right, so decided to build it myself. Existing apps that I've tried were either subscription-based, had a bad design/buggy, didn't come with a library of common drinks I can choose from etc. Pour Decision is my attempt to an app I wanted to exist. Hope y'all like it!

Website:
https://pourdecision.app

I made an alcohol tracker app!

Pour Decision works best for controlling drinking rather than quitting completely. It comes at a one-time payment rather than a subscription model.

Here are some of the features:

- Set personalized goals, log your intake.

- Pre-set DB of common drinks and cocktails.

- Detailed analytics: weekly, monthly and yearly breakdown of all data

- Log water intake, helps remember to hydrate

- Log and track calories, money spent on alcohol

Some of the planned features:

- Apple watch companion app to log from your wrists

- Integration with Apple Health

- Heath map style "year-in-drinking" calendar

What do y'all think?

Website: https://pourdecision.app

Appstore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pour-decision/id6499468185

quotes.text:
Hi everyone!

I made an alcohol tracker, with all the features that I wish other apps had when I was using them. In addition to the features you'd expect from an alcohol tracker, my app offers the following:

- Track water intake → remember to stay hydrated

- Cocktail presets → Presets like beer, wine, tequila etc. isn't unheard of. But I wasn't able to find an app that has presets for common cocktails, which I often go for. I had to investigate what's in the cocktails and log them separately (which was quite bothersome especially while drinking at a bar, and the calorie values were still off) and there were quite some guesswork

- Quick add → Log an entry with an average alcohol content with a single click

And I designed the typical graphs, insights, analytics screens, drink logs display etc. in a way that I find made my overall tracking experience better.

What do y'all think? also, I'm thinking to add a drink calendar that shows your whole year with color coded days, green for 0 drinks, shades from green to yellow for the amount, red for over the limit etc.

Other fun ideas welcome :)
